# Outerworks

> Outerworks is a garden fencing and outdoor works team based in Ruislip (HA4), covering West and North-West London from Uxbridge and Hayes across to Ealing and Acton, and up to Edgware, Mill Hill and Barnet. Its signature offer is The Built-Right Fence: a fixed per-metre price confirmed in writing at a free survey, a guaranteed start date (or £100 a day off the bill if Outerworks is late), and a 12-month workmanship guarantee.

Outerworks is run as a three-way partnership. Fencing is the core trade; the same team also builds gates, decking, pergolas, and sheds on proper bases.

## Services

- [Fencing](https://outerworks.co.uk/services/fencing/) — close board, lap panel, slatted and trellis, on posts set to last
- [Gates](https://outerworks.co.uk/services/gates/) — side, garden and driveway gates matched to the fence
- [Decking](https://outerworks.co.uk/services/decking/) — timber and composite decks on a proper frame
- [Pergolas](https://outerworks.co.uk/services/pergolas/) — timber pergolas, lean-to and freestanding
- [Sheds and shed bases](https://outerworks.co.uk/services/sheds/) — sheds supplied and built on a solid, level base

## The Built-Right Fence

Included as standard on every fencing job:

- Fixed per-metre price, confirmed in writing at the free survey
- Guaranteed start date in writing — £100 off the bill for every day Outerworks starts late
- 12-month workmanship guarantee — any fault on Outerworks fixed within 7 days of being reported
- Premium posts, boards and fixings, named on the quote
- Full site clear and all waste removed (no skip left on the drive)
- Free storm check after the first winter

Three specs:

- **Standard** — pressure-treated lap panels, concrete posts and gravel boards
- **Signature** (most popular) — close board fence built on site with fixings that don't rust-stain
- **Estate** — slatted cedar or composite, with lighting-ready posts

A 25–30% deposit secures the start date and materials; the balance is due on completion. The exact price is confirmed on site at the free survey.

Full details: https://outerworks.co.uk/built-right-fence/

## How it works

1. Send a postcode, what's needed and a rough size — by the website form (opens WhatsApp), WhatsApp, phone or email.
2. Outerworks replies the same day and books a free survey — no call-out fee, no obligation.
3. At the survey, the ground and access are checked and a fixed price and start date are confirmed in writing.
4. The job is built in days, the site is left clean, and the 12-month guarantee and first-winter storm check follow.

## Common questions

- **Is the price really fixed?** Yes. The per-metre band confirmed at survey is what the customer pays. It only changes if the customer changes the spec, and any change is agreed first.
- **What if the ground is bad?** Ground and access are checked at the survey. If something genuinely hidden turns up while digging, work stops and it is agreed with the customer before continuing.
- **How soon can work start?** A start date is given at survey and put in writing, backed by the £100-a-day late-start guarantee.
- **Do I need planning permission for a fence?** Usually not for a back garden fence up to 2 metres, or 1 metre next to a road used by vehicles. Conservation areas can differ; Outerworks checks this at the survey.
- **Why is it dearer than the cheapest quote?** The price is fixed, the start date guaranteed, materials named and the work guaranteed for a year, so customers don't pay twice.
